heard: A new star once cast shadows across the Earth. It appeared in the sky, brighter than the planet Venus. This celestial fire was so intense, people saw it during midday. Astronomer Tycho Brahe proved it sat far beyond our moon. That discovery shattered the myth that the heavens never change. Space dust reflected its original light back to us in 2008. This light echo proved a white dwarf star had completely exploded. A young William Shakespeare likely watched the blast according to research. It remains the ghost star that casts shadows across the Earth.
